intended_use: PBR surface input for v3 rock geometry or rock-cluster materials
asset-level preview before any scene integration

preview.basis: local diffuse, GL normal, and roughness maps are present and hash-verified

processing_requirements: Keep the diffuse/base-color map in sRGB; import normal and roughness as Non-Color data.
Use the GL normal map only after checking tangent/normal convention in the target material.
Do not use this texture set as a transparent photo plane or as a label source.
If displacement is enabled, treat the result as changed geometry and regenerate depth, semantic, and instance labels.
risks: The material page describes a natural weathered rock surface; it does not provide a target mesh or guarantee a match to the existing rock-cluster scale.
The map set is JPEG and 2K; close-up detail and compression artifacts must be checked in preview.
Poly Haven page metadata may change; retain this URL and the local hash when redistributing.

processing_requirements: Keep the diffuse/base-color map in sRGB; import normal and roughness as Non-Color data.

Normal and roughness changes alone do not change depth; any displacement must create a new geometry state and trigger GT regeneration.
Resolve whether the receiving geometry remains semantic 1 sand or semantic 2 rock before formal integration.
risks: The asset is exposed coral ground with gravel and debris, not a complete seabed mesh; tiling and scale must be calibrated.
The map set is JPEG and 2K; close-up detail and compression artifacts must be checked in preview.
The source page lists multiple resolutions; this catalog covers only the local 2K files.

source_variant.version_note: The local filename identifies the 100k-2048 variant; no separate release/version identifier is embedded.

intended_use: branching-coral candidate for isolated asset preview
optional source for static, baked v3 coral variants after import and label gates

preview.basis: local GLB is present, hash-verified, and contains three embedded 2048×2048 JPEG maps

processing_requirements: Keep the GLB as the immutable source; write any converted/baked result under assets/processed/ and add a new hash record.
The embedded base-color RGB map has no ICC profile in the local GLB and should be explicitly imported as sRGB; embedded occlusion and normal data should be Non-Color.
Verify axis, units, origin, pivot, scale, UVs, normals, and manifold/visibility behavior before using the model in a labeled scene.
Assign semantic 3 and a stable instance ID to each approved derived instance; do not let a multi-part import cross semantic classes.
Any remeshing, displacement, or geometry change requires new depth, semantic, instance, and valid-mask exports.
risks: The Smithsonian record is a dry specimen; it is a morphology source, not a live-colony appearance or underwater ecological observation.
The source record contains collection/depth metadata that must not be interpreted as a rendering-water measurement.
The local catalog does not assert triangle count or topology quality; those require a measured import gate.
Texture maps are embedded in the GLB and do not have separate local hashes; the GLB SHA-256 covers the delivered container.
